summary: Extend the existing Log-correction remediation handoff to planning-quality advice and its raw 50-row history limit.
rationale: The audited planning-quality consumer independently classifies raw Log text without correction resolution or source identities. Store-history and completion-report repairs alone leave withdrawn assertions and correction text eligible to drive advice. Record this bounded omission and its acceptance checks while preserving the existing append-only decision and keeping UBU-Q0162 open.

 Status: Open Priority: MVP important Phase: Phase 2 Decision type: Data model Auto-choice eligibility: Human approval required Importance score: TBD Automation-likelihood score: TBD Risk score: TBD Answerability score: 100 Depends on: None Blocks: None Resolved by: None Last scored: 2026-10-19 Scored from commit: None
 
 ### Question
 
 Where does the operator-reported editable Log violate the existing append-only contract, and what minimum implementation correction closes it?
 
 ### Current direction
 
-Append-only Logs and linked corrections are already design rules under `UBU-D0071`, not a newly adopted requirement. Preserve original assertions, correction/revocation links and privacy-minimized media-deletion metadata. Local source audits identify a generic `LogEntry` admission gap reachable through direct, batch and advisory-candidate admission, plus missing annotation/correction link validation, incomplete Log replay comparison at the shared Log writer, missing linked-history discovery and consumers of uncorrected history in routine-duration planning, completion reports, human-complete report counts/notes and reopen actions; the reported edit path, filed remediation ticket and passing implementation evidence remain outstanding.  ### Audit and minimum repair
 
@@ -3094,6 +3094,12 @@ A 2026-10-18 follow-up static audit of the same clean `ubu-orchestrator` revisio
 
 A 2026-10-19 static audit of the same clean `ubu-orchestrator` revision identifies another report consumer outside `calendar_interaction::latest_completion`: `src/router.rs` exposes `GET /reports/human-complete`, and `src/api/reports.rs::human_complete` calls `src/services/report_service.rs::human_complete`. That service and `task_status_counts` count raw Task event types; `notes_from_logs` reads `note` from raw `task_%` payloads. These queries do not follow annotation/correction links. A linked withdrawal leaves the original event countable; linked note replacements/withdrawals leave the original note selected, and linked annotations are excluded. Repairing `latest_completion` alone cannot repair this route. `tests/reports.rs::reports_scaffold_exists` checks file existence only. This is static source evidence, not a reproduction of the reported edit or a passing report result.
 
+A 2026-10-19 follow-up static audit of the same clean `ubu-orchestrator` revision identifies `src/reports/planning_analysis.rs::{load_store_context,failure_pattern,revision_suggestions}` as another independent consumer. `load_store_context` selects the 50 newest raw Log rows by `created_at`, retaining only event type and payload in `LogContext`; `failure_pattern` scans their serialized text for keywords. `derive_reports` uses the result for `human_complete_plan_quality.failure_pattern` and `revision_suggestions`, which `src/services/planning_service.rs::generate` persists with the Plan. Without link resolution or source Log identities, a withdrawn assertion can still drive advice, and annotation/correction text can itself be classified as an independent failure. The raw-row limit can also separate assertions from required links. The unit test `planning_analysis::tests::failure_pattern_and_suggestions_are_model_repairs` supplies one raw `LogContext`, without linked corrections. This is static source evidence, not a reproduction of the reported edit or a passing planning/report result.
+
+Include this planning-quality path in the same remediation handoff. Retain source Log identities and resolve admitted links before classifying applicable corrected assertions and attributed context; link envelopes, withdrawn text and correction reasons are not independent failure observations. Keep recency selection distinct from correction precedence. Discover required links across the raw 50-row boundary with finite traversal budgets; missing, contested or policy-unavailable required evidence must produce an explicit incomplete/review outcome rather than silently returning a complete pattern or `none`. Apply current visibility/retention rules before classification or release and ordinary invalidation/recalculation to affected persisted analysis. Correction interpretation alone changes no canonical Task, UniverseState or applied-effect outcome.
+
+Extend `ubu-orchestrator`'s `tests/planning_o9.rs` through `POST /planning/generate`, plus focused `planning_analysis` tests, with admitted annotations, scoped note replacements/withdrawals, whole-assertion withdrawals and chained/competing corrections referencing only prior Log ids. Assert actual `human_complete_plan_quality.failure_pattern` and `revision_suggestions` use each applicable source assertion once; a withdrawal whose correction reason still contains `overrun` must not itself sustain `wrong_estimates`. Put required links on opposite sides of the raw 50-row boundary. Exercise equivalent direct/batch admission and exact replay, restart, missing dependencies and authorized payload purge; unresolved evidence stays explicit and denied text cannot reappear in advice or persisted analysis. Preserve unrelated report fields, originals, prior links and Task/UniverseState state. Repeated corrected-view resolution emits no Log, receipt or compensation; ordinary Plan generation retains its existing admission behavior. These are required checks, not passing results.
+
 Proposed implementation remediation ticket: **Enforce Log-only admission for `LogEntry` and append linked corrections** in `ubu-store`; file it and link it to `UBU-Q0162`. Reject generic `LogEntry` creates and updates at the shared admission boundary, including `BatchWrite::Object` and `src/candidates.rs::admit_advisory_candidate`, while retaining `LogEntry` in the ID registry. Use Log admission for fresh entries and linked annotations/corrections as specified above. At the shared Log writer `src/queries.rs::append_prepared_log`, reject a fresh append whose id is already held by a legacy `objects` row, including `BatchWrite::Log`, within the admission transaction and independently of the origin Device or idempotency key; preserve ordinary successful Log replay. Inventory any legacy `objects` rows of this type and any ids shared by `objects` and `logs` before repair; preserve policy-permitted originals and links, and surface conflicting identities through ordinary review rather than overwriting or silently dropping history. Attach the running-revision reproduction and UI/CLI-to-writer trace when established.
 
 The same remediation ticket must validate `log_annotation_added`/`annotation_of` and `log_correction_added`/`correction_of` at `src/queries.rs::append_prepared_log`, within the admission transaction and before a new entry or receipt is written. Require the applicable link to identify a distinct admitted original under current authority and visibility policy. Drafts and advisory candidates cannot establish a Log target; unresolved legacy identity collisions use ordinary review. Missing required imported history remains staged under existing dependency rules. Policy-permitted minimized target metadata may establish a link after authorized payload removal; validation must not retrieve or reconstruct purged content.
